field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF and final records support 40 source-located activity rows: 22 Lf-KR MIC/MBC cells from Table 1, 12 temperature-stability MIC cells from Table 2, and 6 serum-stability MIC cells from Table 3. Figure observations are preserved separately with approximate/exact status and are not promoted to exact table facts.

Authoritative DBAASP/merged linked article, assay, sequence, and literature rows are all absent after local index checks. The 12 DBAASP fallback rows remain unresolved machine candidates only: source_verified=0 and unresolved_record=12, with no fallback row promoted to authoritative ingest.

The paper final and packet final mirrors are byte-identical for all five shared JSON artifacts; the packet-only mechanism_evidence.json is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json. Final counts are activity_records=40, toxicity_records=17, database_record_audits=12, mechanism_claims=5, review_rework_targets=0. review_report.semantic_quality_checks.open_rework_ticket_count=0 matches live packet rework state after responses close all three tickets.

All five mechanism claims have claim_id, claim_text, evidence_class, entity_scope, and source_locator. The two direct_mechanism claims are limited to NPN/PI membrane-permeability assays and LPS-binding assay; growth/time-kill, qPCR/in vivo, and sequence/family reasoning remain phenotype_supported or inferred_mechanism rather than direct.

The paper identity is source-supported: title, DOI 10.1186/s12866-025-03906-8, PMID 40165061, PMCID PMC11956232, peptide Lf-KR, sequence RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR-NH2 in source display, plain sequence RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR, and C-terminal amidation as a separate modification. The plain sequence contains 19 residues.

A recursive JSON scan found 114 sequence/sequence_length objects and two unresolved mismatches, exactly matching the current strict acceptance hard findings. Both stale work/preflight surfaces declare sequence_length=20 for the plain one-letter sequence RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR, while independent residue count is 19 and terminal amidation is not a residue.

No recursive authority promotion was found. Fallback machine rows remain excluded from RC2, portal, and authoritative ingest: authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false, promoted_to_authoritative_ingest=false, promoted_to_source_verified=false, and source_record_links_present=false.

Source conflicts and cautions are preserved rather than smoothed: method/table temperature mismatch, method/table serum wording mismatch, abstract/results toxicity threshold wording mismatch, and in vivo survival range not dose-assigned in prose. Review cautions also preserve absent authoritative DBAASP rows, fallback candidate-only rows, and figure digitization as candidate/approximate where appropriate.

The staged supplement is readable and exhausted: one DOCX was inspected directly and through packet extraction, yielding Table S1 strain clinical metadata and Table S2 qPCR primers. Supplementary index/text/tables report one file, two tables, no archives, and zero extraction errors or unrecoverable material gaps.

Toxicity/selectivity coverage is source-located and status-aware: 17 toxicity records include HK-2 qualitative prose, HK-2 Figure 6A OD450 bars, hemolysis prose, and Figure 6B hemolysis bars. Approximate bar-derived values remain labelled approximate, and Figure 7 in vivo survival endpoints are kept in the figure quantitative observations with exact plotted day-7 plateau status.

blocking_findings.reason: The current strict acceptance artifact still has two hard sequence_length_mismatch findings. The primary source displays Lf-KR as RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR-NH2, so the plain one-letter sequence RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR independently counts to 19 residues; C-terminal amidation is a separate terminal modification. Two current work/preflight JSON surfaces still declare sequence_length=20 for that same plain sequence, so publication-grade PASS cannot be issued around the hard findings even though the final activity/database records now use length 19.
required_actions: Repair or supersede the worker-2/preflight sequence-length evidence surfaces so every object pairing a plain one-letter sequence with sequence_length reports 19 for RRWQWRPKRIVKLIKKWLR.
Preserve C-terminal amidation only in modification/display fields, not as an additional residue in sequence_length.
Regenerate the strict acceptance audit after repair; do not mark publication-grade ready while strict_worker_run_gate.hard_finding_count remains nonzero.
